reasons: Compliant claim is consistent with the cited text: the Field of Use definition (p0007) and the grant/reservation language (p0030, p0043) are license-scope limits on how the Licensed Technology may be used, not covenants restricting the businesses we operate or the products we may buy or build; the express non-exclusivity confirms we remain free to use or build competing FX platforms.
No 'shall not compete/develop/market competing products' covenant binds Licensee in the cited paragraphs, so the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Customer) is met.

The three-year post-term non-solicitation in p0125 is a personnel covenant, correctly treated as outside the scope of a non-compete/field-of-use rule; it should be raised (if at all) under a non-solicit/restrictive-covenant rule rather than double-flagged here.
Change-of-control consent and ROFR points are properly noted as belonging to the assignment/change-of-control rules, avoiding duplicate flagging of the same commercial term.

Consistent with a compliant status, the rendered redline is identical to the original text and no counterparty comment is proposed; the deterministic check also confirms no open-ended compete restriction remains.
